description: Velnor: propose ALL updates (major + minor/patch) as reviewed changes; never merge. Covers the Cargo dependencies, the Mise pins in mise.toml and .velnor/mise.toml, the [[actions]] pins in .velnor/version-policy.toml; the workflows velnor-gen writes under .github/workflows are ignored, so only the hand-maintained ci.yml gets action-pin updates.

customManagers.description: Action pins recorded in the source version policy: name, version tag and full commit SHA of each [[actions]] entry.

packageRules.description: ci.yml's mise-action `version:` input is read by Renovate as a jdx/mise release tag, so it is looked up. The tag is written v-prefixed (v2026.11.1) because the bare form 404s; mise-action strips the v. Bumps are not proposed: the input is paired with a pinned sha256, and a version-only bump would fail checksum verification.
Cargo majors need explicit migration review (VER-3.2: incompatible = migration, never silent).
Cargo minor/patch updates ride the normal qualification gate.
The Rust toolchain and the MBX wrapper are qualified by the owner and mirrored in rust-toolchain.toml and the version policy, so Renovate leaves them alone.
A bump of a Mise pin is a reviewed change: mise.lock, .velnor/mise.lock and the version policy are refreshed by hand in the same pull request (docs/implemented/update-procedure.md).
x509-cert 0.3 makes tbs_certificate private (E0616); upgrading is a code change, so hold 0.2.x until that lands.
The alint pin is a reviewed policy pin; changes need policy review.
